offering_description.value: Chemed provides end-of-life care to patients through its hospice programs. It serves homeowners, businesses and municipalities with plumbing, drain cleaning and water cleanup through company-owned branches, independent contractors and franchisees.

quotes.quote: VITAS Healthcare Corporation is one of the nation's largest, long-standing mission-focused providers of end-of-life are services. Based in Miami, Florida, VITAS operates 59 hospice programs in 15 states (Alabama, California, Connecticut, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Kansas, Missouri, New Jersey, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Texas, Virginia, and Wisconsin) and the District of Columbia. Please visit the VITAS website at www.vitas.com for more information.

Roto-Rooter offers an ever-expanding variety of plumbing repair and maintenance, drain cleaning and water cleanup services to homeowners, businesses and municipalities. Roto-Rooter operates multiple company-owned branches and independent contractors and 345 franchisees. The total Roto-Rooter system offers services to more than 90% of the U.S. population and approximately 30% of the Canadian population. Please visit the Roto-Rooter website at www.rotorooter.com for more information.
